sentences.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
sentences.zh: 消防队员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。

sentences.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们一直在设法查明起火的原因。

sentences.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
sentences.zh: 森林火灾常常是由碎玻璃或人们乱扔的烟头引起的。

chunks.x: by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away

sentences.en: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully,
sentences.zh: 昨天消防队员仔细地查看了地面，

sentences.en: but were not able to find any broken glass.
sentences.zh: 但没能找到任何碎玻璃。

chunks.x: able to find any broken glass

sentences.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们也很肯定不是烟头引起的大火。

chunks.x: that a cigarette end did not start the fire
quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire

sentences.en: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.
sentences.zh: 然而今天早上，一个消防队员偶然发现了起火的原因。

sentences.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.
sentences.zh: 他注意到一条蛇的残骸，它缠绕在一条16,000伏高压线的电线上。

chunks.x: of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16 000 volt power line
round the electric wires of a 16 000 volt power line

sentences.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
sentences.zh: 就这样，他解开了这个谜。

sentences.en: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
sentences.zh: 解释很简单，但很不寻常。

sentences.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟把蛇从地上叼起来，又把它扔到了电线上。

sentences.en: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
sentences.zh: 它这样一来，火花掉到地上，立即引起了火灾。
